metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: DEWGEU crystallizes in the hexagonal crystal system with space group P -6 c 2. Reported CIF formula moiety: C114 H177 N27 Nd20 Ni21 O168,32(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Nd1 (Nd) has 9 O neighbors; Nd2 (Nd) has 9 O neighbors; Nd3 (Nd) has 8 O neighbors; Nd4 (Nd) has 9 O neighbors; Ni1 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni2 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni3 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni4 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Nd1A (Nd) has 9 O neighbors; Nd2A (Nd) has 9 O neighbors; Nd3A (Nd) has 8 O neighbors; Ni1A (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni2A (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni3A (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni4A (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Nd1B (Nd) has 9 O neighbors; Nd2B (Nd) has 9 O neighbors; Nd3B (Nd) has 8 O neighbors; Ni1B (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni2B (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni3B (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni4B (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Nd1C (Nd) has 9 O neighbors; Nd2C (Nd) has 9 O neighbors; Nd3C (Nd) has 8 O neighbors; Nd4C (Nd) has 9 O neighbors; Ni1C (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni2C (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni4C (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Nd1D (Nd) has 9 O neighbors; Nd2D (Nd) has 9 O neighbors; Nd3D (Nd) has 8 O neighbors; Ni1D (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni2D (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni4D (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Nd1E (Nd) has 9 O neighbors; Nd2E (Nd) has 9 O neighbors; Nd3E (Nd) has 8 O neighbors; Ni1E (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni2E (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni4E (Ni) has 5 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 69 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.500-4.205 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 99.00-118.18°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Nd20Ni21(IDA)21(NH2CH2COO)6(OAc)3(CO3)6(C2O4)3(μ3-O)9(μ3-OH)12(μ2-OH)3·12H2O]·32H2O; empirical formula C114H241N27Nd20Ni21O200. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 3 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 9 μ3-O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 12 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 3 μ2-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
